# NewMouth

> NewMouth is a trusted resource for evidence-based dental health information, covering oral conditions, preventive care, and treatment options across all age groups.

NewMouth provides comprehensive guides to oral health conditions, diseases, and prevention strategies, with expert-reviewed content spanning general dentistry, pediatric care, and specialized dental health topics. The site features contributions from dental professionals affiliated with leading institutions including Baylor College of Dentistry and UCLA School of Dentistry.

## Key Topics

- oral health
- gum disease
- cavity prevention
- dental hygiene
- periodontal disease
- dental care
- tooth decay
- family dentistry
- pediatric dentistry
- restorative dentistry
- gingivitis
- fluoride
- dental treatments
- health conditions
- prevention

## Oral Health Conditions & Diseases

- [Oral Health: Common Conditions, Diseases & Prevention Tips](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health): Comprehensive guide to oral health conditions, diseases, and prevention strategies.
- [Gum Disease: Causes, Prevention & Treatment](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/gum-disease): Comprehensive guide to gum disease causes, prevention, and treatment options.
- [Oral Cancer (Mouth Cancer): Types, Causes & Treatment](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/oral-cancer): Guide to oral cancer types, causes, and treatment options with HPV information.
- [Images and Early Signs of Cavities](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/what-do-cavities-look-like): Visual guide to cavity identification with images and early warning signs.
- [Halitosis (Bad Breath): Causes, Treatment, and Prevention](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/halitosis): Complete guide to bad breath causes, treatments, and prevention strategies.
- [What is Temporomandibular Joint Dysfunction (TMD)?](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/tmj): Guide to TMD causes, symptoms, and treatment options for jaw disorders.
- [Oral STDs - Symptoms, Causes, Prevention & Treatment](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/oral-stds): Educational guide to oral STDs, symptoms, prevention, and treatment.

## Dental Care by Life Stage

- [Babies Dental Care: Common Oral Conditions & Prevention](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/family/babies): Guide to baby dental care, conditions, and prevention strategies.
- [Dental Care for Children: Conditions, Treatment & Prevention](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/family/children): Comprehensive guide to children's dental care and cavity prevention.
- [Dental Care for Teens: Oral Health Risks, Treatments & More](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/family/teens): Guide to teen dental care, orthodontics, and oral health risks.
- [Adult Dental Care: Common Conditions & Treatments Options](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/family/adults): Guide to adult dental care, common conditions, and treatment options.

## Dentistry Services & Procedures

- [General Dentists: Common Services & Procedures](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/general): Overview of general dentistry services, procedures, and treatment options.
- [Sleep Apnea Disorders: Causes, Treatment Options & More](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/general/sleep-apnea): Comprehensive guide to sleep apnea types, causes, and treatment options.
- [Cleft Lip and Palate: Causes, Risks & Treatment Timeline](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/pediatric/conditions/cleft-lip-and-palate): Guide to cleft lip and palate causes, risks, and treatment timelines.

## Oral Health & Systemic Health Connections

- [How Your General Health Standing Impacts Your Oral Health](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/effects): Guide on how lifestyle and general health impact oral health outcomes.
- [How Diabetes Impacts Your Oral Health Standing](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/effects/diabetes): Guide to oral health complications associated with diabetes management.
- [Physical Disabilities & Oral Health](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/effects/physical-disabilities): Guide to oral health care for people with physical disabilities.

## Optional Resources

- [How Many Teeth Do Humans Have? (Adults & Babies)](https://www.newmouth.com/blog/how-many-teeth): Educational article on dental anatomy covering adult and baby teeth counts.
- [Are Mouth Sores a Symptom of COVID-19?](https://www.newmouth.com/blog/oral-hygiene-covid19): Article on mouth sores as COVID-19 symptoms and treatment options.
